items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: And I played drums with him for quite a while... And I played drums with him, Henry Ford, the young one.

ctx.x: Like, did you know Freddie Gould and Henry Ford and those?

Yeah, I knew them. Henry Ford, tell you the truth, if you're talking about the elder days, two Henry Fords, a young one and an older one. And the young one, he was a violinist. And I played drums with him for quite a while, you know, he had three or four, he didn't have a big orchestra, three or four people. And I played drums with him, Henry Ford, the young one. And the older one? And I knew the father, I knew the older one. What did he play? He was a bass violin player. Uh-huh, I see.

When you said you started playing drums in 1930, how long did you play drums for yourself? I didn't play too long, about two years, I think. And you started, you mean professionally, you were playing with bands? Yeah, yeah, yeah. And then you switched to the trumpet.
